notes.title: Lizards Must Die 2 - The official announcement of the game 2025
notes.content:
IMPORTANT NEWS! Russ vs Lizards 2 will be released on March 27, 2025. That is, IN 10 DAYS!!! Add to the wishlist on  Steam and GET READY to slay LIZARDS with your friends! The game will be released fully at once without early access and demos, JUST THE WAY WE LIKE IT. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107800/RUSY_PROTIV_YASHHEROV_2/?l=russian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/194ebd91b713542f634afa0a0c105cefcbaf5903.jpg[/img]

Right now the development is fully finished, Steam has already approved the project, so WE're POLISHING the GAME and are getting ready to PRESS the DESIRED RELEASE BUTTON. The game will also be available on VKPlay.

And now a little bit about what awaits you in the game.:

- The main campaign, which lasts from 3 to 3,000 hours (it all depends on the style of your game)
- Wave mode, where you can test your strength against hordes of lizards
- Cooperative for up to 4 people
- 4 unique playable characters: Vyacheslav Sergey's son, Vseslav the Magician, Viktor Korneplod and Mstislav Dubolyub. Each with its own unique style of play and abilities (from Lightning of Perun to Ass Kick Ability)
- A complete story - 9 full-fledged missions that reveal the story of the Great War of the Rus and Lizards and the Battle for Hyperborea.
- THE MOST BEAUTIFUL LOCATIONS. Russian villages, Lizard factories, streets of Hyperborea
- Different types of opponents. The cunning lizards not only run at you with sticks in their hands, but also use reptilian technologies - guns, bombs, cannons, as well as LIZARD MATHEMATICS.
- BOSSES! You'll have to work hard to defeat them.
- Additional game mechanics. You can shoot a cannon, ride a cart, ride or scratch the ears of DINOSAURS.
- Roffles and a bunch of DIALOGUES with tons of REFERENCES
- THE MOST POWERFUL Exclusive SOUNDTRACK in the FONK FOLK genre.
- GOIDA AND EGG CLAMP
- And much more

We look forward to presenting you the results of a year of work by our small team!

We are not waiting, but we are preparing, there are only 10 days left!

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER - BIG UPDATE FOR LIZARDS MUST DIE
notes.content:
Have a good day, Slavic brothers!

Today, finally, according to your requests, we are releasing a major addition for the Lizards must die  game. Call your bros and friends, now the treacherous lizards can be scattered together! Drink strong kvass or Baikal water, and go into battle!

What awaits you, Russian brothers:
1) Cooperative game mode. Hit the become a voivode button and invite your friends to join your adventures!
2) The opportunity to play with 4 or even 5, if you really want, heroes!
3) New adventures of Rus - map of AFRICA! Help the black-Russian brothers to clear the pyramids of foot-and-mouth disease
4) New types of snake lizards in Africa, a new enemy and a new miniboss
5) A new character is Mstislav Dubolyub, a master of a two-handed club, slow but POWERFUL
6) WE FIXED A LOT OF BUGS, lizards now don't kick your ass at any point in the game, and alien herods don't trample the player 24/7
7) Two new achievements
8) Another new character is VICTOR, the master of the spear and shield, an original skin and a new appearance, all proceeds will go to the development of a NEW GAME

[previewyoutube=IX7pgd6o-2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Good luck to everyone in co-op mode, GOIDA BROTHERS! The mode is already available, just update the game on Steam

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/ef1529863dab3b9880ba71d6b47a5932c5a1dd1f.png[/img]

notes.title: RUS On the MOON - Lizards MUST DIE First Addon to the GAME
notes.content:
RUS brothers! The time has come to show Herods to foreigners that it is not worth attacking the land of the Great Rus. As part of the SPACE PROGRAM OF THE ANCIENT RUS, you can go to the REPTILOID base on the MOON in order to preemptively attack the ALIENS who have conceived something amiss and cheerfully crumble their booths to beautiful music.

THEY ARE WAITING FOR YOU:
- A new large MOON location with new landscapes and truly cosmic scales
- Lack of loading screens as part of moving between planets
- Wild mix with a huge number of opponents, maybe even without FPS dropdown
- A new BOSS and a new type of enemies
- A new level with 15 Waves, which YOU WILL HAVE to SWEAT to pass
- New POWERFUL tracks for killing LIZARDS and ALIENS
- Updated hero RADISLAV

We also launched the most powerful discounts on all The Bratans games!

[previewyoutube=SZe9ad3jwJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The God-pleasing patch of the first day of the Rusa vs Lizards game
notes.content:
Brothers, they gave us three days to fix it, and we did it in a week.


1) Now the problem with the black screen has been precisely fixed, optimization has been carried out, the game can work on weaker machines
2) Menu size for 4:3 screens and Steam Boards
3) Improved collisions, now rus can't walk through houses
4) Fixed a bug with the fact that Rus could climb on the enemy
5) Fixed a bug when the hero wants to drink all the time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5edb4a53127b80b99e6f5c1836ed5016eab63ab1.jpg[/img]
